About the Role

Notion is looking for a Recruiting Program Manager to help design, build, and scale the systems and programs that power how we hire. This is a role for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and doesn't wait to be told what to do — someone who operates with both strategic altitude and operational precision, and knows how to bring clarity and momentum to complex cross-functional work.

We're at an inflection point in how we think about recruiting at Notion, and this role sits at the center of it. You'll partner closely with Recruiters, Recruiting Operations, People Operations, and senior leadership to drive some of our highest-priority initiatives — building the programs and processes that define how Notion finds, evaluates, and brings in exceptional talent.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

The scope of this role will evolve with the team's highest priorities. Some examples of what you might work on:

  • Interviewer systems and efficacy — design the systems, structures, and standards that make Notion's interviewing reliably great: how we train interviewers, how we measure their effectiveness, how we calibrate quality over time, and how we continuously raise the bar; this includes programs like Interviewer 101, Hiring Manager Training, and functional interviewer certifications tailored to specific teams

  • Interviewer pool health — own the systems and strategy behind how we maintain a healthy, well-mapped interviewer pool, manage AI and experimental interview formats, and keep quality high at scale

  • Recruiting team onboarding and enablement — build and run programs that get new recruiters up to speed quickly and keep the team operating at a high level

  • Specialty hiring programs — provide program management support for specialized hiring motions like internal mobility, M&A integration, and other high-priority strategic initiatives

  • Cross-functional playbooks and infrastructure — build the processes, communications, and coordination frameworks that help Recruiting run with more consistency, clarity, and scale

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in program management, recruiting operations, or a highly cross-functional role in a fast-moving environment

  • High agency — you move fast, take ownership end-to-end, and don't wait for perfect information or explicit direction to get started. Ambiguity doesn't scare you.

  • Builder mentality — you're most energized when creating something new or improving something that doesn't yet work well

  • Strong AI skills — think beyond generative AI. We're looking for folks with hands-on experience building custom agents, skills, etc and have taught them to others. You're genuinely excited about using AI to change how a core business function works

  • Strong project management skills — you can lead complex initiatives from scoping through execution, managing stakeholders, timelines, and competing priorities along the way; you're equally comfortable driving short-term sprints and stewarding long-range programs that evolve over months or years

  • Proven ability to operate with discretion and high judgment on sensitive or high-profile work

  • Strong analytical instincts — you use data to evaluate program health, spot patterns, and make informed decisions

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication — you tailor your message to the audience and create clarity across all levels of the organization

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with recruiting program management workstreams through different stages of recruiting evolution

  • You use Notion and love it — you get what we're building

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.

This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.

This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Do

  • Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

  • Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

  • Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

  • Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

  • Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

  • Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

  • Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

  • Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

  • Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

  • Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.

What You'll Need

  • A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

  • Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

  • Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

  • A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

  • Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

  • Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

  • Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building account-based marketing programs.

  • Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

  • Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.

Why This Role

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.

The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $245,000 – $275,000 per year.

About the Role:

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view — someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market — and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.

  • Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day — launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.

  • Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.

  • Maintain and improve our release comms channels — including notion.com/releases and What's New emails — partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.

  • Experience running product launches and adoption programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.

  • Strong cross-functional skills — comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

  • Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.

  • Sharp writing and storytelling instincts — you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.

Nice to Haves:

  • You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.

  • You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration

  • You're a pro at building and using agents — inside Notion and beyond.

  • PMM experience at a larger company — though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.



What You'll Achieve

  • Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

  • Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

  • Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

  • Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

  • Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

  • Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

  • Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.

Skills You’ll Need to Bring

  • Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

  • Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

  • Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

  • Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

  • Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

  • Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

  • Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

  • Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

  • You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

  • Fluent in English and French

Nice to Haves

  • Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

  • Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

  • Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

  • Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

  • Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

  • Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is building the connected workspace that teams everywhere use to think, plan, and ship — and our partner ecosystem is central to how we grow in the UK market. As Regional Partner Manager for UK, you'll own our partner relationships across the region, working closely with our London sales team to drive revenue through value-added resellers, hyperscaler ecosystems, and local services partners.

This is a builder role for someone who thrives in a dynamic, high-growth environment. You'll be the architect of Notion's UK partner motion — standing up programs, forging relationships, and converting partner activity into measurable pipeline. You'll operate across multiple partner types simultaneously and serve as the connective tissue between our ecosystem and our sales team.

The ideal candidate brings a hunter's instinct to partnerships: proactive, commercially sharp, and energised by the challenge of building something meaningful in a market with real momentum. You'll work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and regional leadership — and you'll be a visible face of Notion in the UK partner community.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own and grow Notion's UK partner ecosystem across value-added resellers, cloud/hyperscaler partnerships, and local services partners

  • Build and execute joint go-to-market programs with regional VARs and solutions partners

  • Manage Notion's hyperscaler partnerships in the UK, overseeing cloud marketplace deal flow and co-sell motions

  • Align partner activity directly to the UK sales team's pipeline — facilitating introductions, mapping accounts, and driving resell and co-sell opportunities to close

  • Coordinate joint initiatives that bring together reseller partners and hyperscaler ecosystems for combined enterprise programs

  • Develop and maintain strong executive relationships with partner leadership across the region, becoming a trusted extension of their go-to-market teams

  • Track and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline; present program performance to internal stakeholders and EMEA regional leadership

  • Support services delivery by local partners on an ad-hoc basis, helping maintain quality and partner satisfaction

  • Identify and qualify inbound partnership opportunities, and proactively surface new partner relationships that can expand Notion's reach in the UK

  • Collaborate with Notion's global and EMEA partner teams to adapt programs to the local market and share learnings across regions

Skills you’ll need to bring

  • 10+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or alliances in the enterprise SaaS or cloud software industry

  • Demonstrated experience managing both VAR/reseller programs and at least one cloud or hyperscaler partnership — comfort across both partner types is essential

  • A builder's track record: you've stood up partner programs and can point to outcomes you drove

  • Strong demand generation orientation

  • Commercially sharp with the ability to connect partner activity to revenue outcomes

  • Highly collaborative and effective working alongside direct sales teams — you understand what reps need, and you make their lives easier

  • Executive presence and strong relationship-building skills; you're as comfortable presenting to a partner CRO as you are coordinating logistics with a partner marketing manager

  • Experience working in or alongside hyper-growth or startup environments — you're comfortable with ambiguity and moving fast without a complete playbook

  • Based in London with existing knowledge of the UK technology market; willingness to travel across EMEA and occasionally across EMEA

  • Strong organisational and operational discipline — you manage multiple active partner relationships without dropping balls, and you communicate proactively

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud marketplace programs and hyperscaler co-sell motions

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) or bottoms-up SaaS go-to-market models

  • Existing relationships with UK-based VARs, systems integrators, or hyperscaler partner teams

  • Cross-market EMEA experience — e.g. managing partnerships across EMEA regions simultaneously

About the role

You’ll be responsible for analyzing business processes, identifying areas for improvement, designing and implementing solutions to unlock our sales team. Your knowledge of sales processes will be instrumental in implementing critical systems to unlock our business goals.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with RevOps, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to turn real deal friction into durable systems: clearer processes, smarter automation, and a quoting experience that helps the team move faster with confidence.

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What you’ll achieve

  • Analyze business processes and sales systems to identify improvement opportunities

  • Independently drive tasks and projects end to end (requirements, analysis, design, implementation, thorough testing, launch, and ongoing support).

  • Manage Salesforce configuration through a governed change management process - building and maintaining Flows, custom objects, validation rules, and security controls with sandbox-first development, documentation, and aligned with platform best practices.

  • Collaborate proactively with business stakeholders and the Corporate Systems team to deliver durable solutions.

  • Partner with senior admins and developers to configure solutions across core CRM data models (Accounts, Opportunities, lead-to-opportunity processes, and related custom objects).

  • Support stakeholders with day-to-day system questions, unblock workflows, and become a trusted Salesforce admin partner

  • Ensure thorough testing, documentation, and clear communication for all system changes.

  • Look for everyday ways AI can accelerate your work, simplify seller processes, and reduce manual steps.

Skills you’ll bring

  • You are Salesforce Admin certified.

  • 7+ years of experience as a Sales Business Systems Analyst and/or providing Salesforce support.

  • Experience with a CPQ implementation and deep knowledge of quote-to-cash (and other sales functional processes).

  • Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud best practices, including building Flows, validation rules, and reports.

  • AI-native builder mindset: comfortable using AI tools to accelerate development, generate code, build agents, and draft clear requirements; eager to keep leveling up.

  • Ability to map processes and translate needs into user stories, with strong stakeholder collaboration.

  • Experience working in Agile environments and partnering effectively with development teams.

Nice to Have

  • Certified Salesforce CPQ Specialist

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.

  • This role will support the growth and maturity of product support programs by identifying areas of improvement, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to refine support processes, policies, and tooling, and serving as one of the drivers of product support excellence within Customer Experience (CX).

  • Manage executive-level product escalations end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, customer updates, and coordination with global product and engineering teams to drive timely and effective resolution.

  • The successful candidate should have deep product support expertise, strong experience driving process improvements, and a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally, along with experience managing and developing high-performing teams of product support specialists across multiple levels.

  • Analyze data regularly and drive continuous improvement.

  • Maintain and report on KPIs and provide ad hoc reporting as necessary.

  • Proactively identify areas for improvement and own the implementation of necessary changes to CX support processes. Own, coordinate and ship process improvements in collaboration with the User Ops, and influence on behalf of CX for cross-functionally owned processes and tools.

  • Participate in the global on-call rotation to cover incidents.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 8+ years of work experience in Product support team of a software company.

  • 3+ years of work experience in leading and managing a Product support team.

  • You have deep understanding of the nuance of managing product support and executive escalations, and can apply that to improve the customer experience.

  • You are extremely user-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.

  • You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.

  • Strong technical support foundations, including log reading and basic debugging, core API concepts, webhook fundamentals, and SSO basics (OAuth and SAML).

  • Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

  • Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end-to-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.

  • You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Experience handling business intelligence tools and systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Hex, Looker.

  • Experience building robust and scalable processes spanning across go-to-market and technical teams.

  • Ability to deep dive and own projects individually while also delegating and empowering team members to deliver.

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up environment

  • You are familiar with and/or a user of Notion

This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. You will own the strategy and execution of your team’s segment.

The Outcomes Architect team is a new function at Notion that combines RM, CSM and SE capabilities to drive workflow adoption and retention at our customers.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Increase Team Performance on Adoption, Retention, and Customer Value: Your role centers on up-leveling the team to boost product adoption, retention, customer value, and satisfaction through effective retention strategies and churn prevention in the Enterprise segment (note that your team will own a subset of renewals).

  • Team Leadership and Development: As a leader, you'll recruit, train, and mentor a high-performing Outcomes Architect team that embodies our core values and operational goals.

  • Data-Driven Insights and Operational Excellence: You will build and refine a consistent KPI/OKR system that enables data-driven decisions to identify risks, trends, and opportunities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Partnerships: You will partner with solutions consulting and forward deployed engineers to ensure smooth customer onboarding and continuously refine the customer journey to drive long-term success. You will also bridge the gap between customers and internal teams by channeling feedback into product development, ensuring continuous improvement of the platform.

  • AI Workflow Adoption: You and your team will drive new workflows and build beside customers to implement them.

  • Customer Leadership: You will serve as the key extension of your team for high-stakes customer engagements (both internally and externally), such as business reviews.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 5+ years of people management experience for a CS, sales, SE or account management team

  • Experience with large and strategic customers (experience with Fortune 500)

  • Experience working with technical stakeholders

  • Experience driving AI adoption

  • Can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely and resolve tradeoffs

  • Effective communicator across levels and audiences

  • Strong leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive-mindsets, collaboration and ability to inspire a team of direct reports

  • High ownership mentality

  • Comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of an early-stage startup

  • Growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of a nascent team

Nice to Haves:

  • You have experience using Notion

  • You've built new CS playbooks or processes

  • Experience using Gainsight

  • Experienced in hiring and training talent at scale

  • Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

  • Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

  • Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

  • Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption

  • 1-3 years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

  • Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

  • Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

  • You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

  • You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working

Nice to Haves

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions

    • Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

  • Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

About The Role

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

What You'll Achieve

  • Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

  • Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

  • Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

  • Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

  • Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

  • Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

  • Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

  • Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

  • Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

  • Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

  • Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

  • Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

  • Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

  • Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

  • Written and spoken Japanese fluency to communicate directly with external customers, partners, and internal teams

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

  • Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

  • Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

  • Business level English proficiency to communicate effectively with global stakeholders and peers.

  • Experience working with Japanese enterprise customers or familiarity with Japan market dynamics and business practices.

About The Role

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

What You'll Achieve

  • Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

  • Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

  • Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

  • Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

  • Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

  • Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

  • Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

  • Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

  • You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

  • You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working

Nice to Haves

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions

    • Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

  • Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

About the Role:

Notion is growing rapidly and shipping new features and product improvements at a high rate to meet the needs of our customers.

The User Operations team is a function of the Customer Experience (CX) team maintaining clear lines of communication between customers and Product, ensuring customers get the most out of Notion and that their feedback is integrated into the product development process.

As the Technical Quality Program Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining world class support experiences related to product quality. You’ll be responsible for improving the bug reporter experience and maintaining and scaling processes for tracking and resolution of user issues related to product quality and feature requests.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Manage critical user experiences and internal workflows focused on improving product quality, influencing the development of new features, and supporting end users at scale

  • Continuously improve Notion’s bug-reporting and feature request funnels, from user-facing intake to escalation, tagging, tracking, reporting, and followup

  • Make data-informed recommendations for how to collect and prioritize feature requests, scale internal escalation processes, and resolve bugs and other product quality issues

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to measure and drive CX’s bug management effectiveness and efficiency through tooling, process, and training improvements

  • Collaborate with Engineering to improve incident management workflows, ensuring clear escalation paths, timely communication, and effective resolution of customer-impacting issues

  • Build and maintain documentation, trainings, and QA processes for customer support issues related to quality, reliability, performance, and qualitative product feedback

  • Be an advocate for our customers and a thought partner to CX and Product partners

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 3-5 years experience in customer support operations, product operations, technical support, customer experience, or related field

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to streamline cross-functional programs or processes

  • Experience working directly with engineers, product managers, or other technical roles as well as CX or customer-facing roles

  • Demonstrated experience solving ambiguous problems and using data to build consensus

  • Previous responsibility tracking and analyzing key operational metrics to ensure KPIs/service goals are met

Nice to Haves:

  • Notion product expertise

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification

  • Technical knowledge or data querying experience (SQL)

  • Experience contributing to the product development process at a software company

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $61.54 – $67.79 hourly.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing rapidly and shipping new features and product improvements at a high rate to meet the needs of our customers.

The User Operations team is a function of the Customer Experience (CX) team maintaining clear lines of communication between customers and Product, ensuring customers get the most out of Notion and that their feedback is integrated into the product development process.

As the Technical Quality Program Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining world class support experiences related to product quality. You’ll be responsible for improving the bug reporter experience and maintaining and scaling processes for tracking and resolution of user issues related to product quality and feature requests.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage critical user experiences and internal workflows focused on improving product quality, influencing the development of new features, and supporting end users at scale

 - Continuously improve Notion’s bug-reporting and feature request funnels, from user-facing intake to escalation, tagging, tracking, reporting, and followup

 - Make data-informed recommendations for how to collect and prioritize feature requests, scale internal escalation processes, and resolve bugs and other product quality issues

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to measure and drive CX’s bug management effectiveness and efficiency through tooling, process, and training improvements

 - Collaborate with Engineering to improve incident management workflows, ensuring clear escalation paths, timely communication, and effective resolution of customer-impacting issues

 - Build and maintain documentation, trainings, and QA processes for customer support issues related to quality, reliability, performance, and qualitative product feedback

 - Be an advocate for our customers and a thought partner to CX and Product partners




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3-5 years experience in customer support operations, product operations, technical support, customer experience, or related field

 - Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to streamline cross-functional programs or processes

 - Experience working directly with engineers, product managers, or other technical roles as well as CX or customer-facing roles

 - Demonstrated experience solving ambiguous problems and using data to build consensus

 - Previous responsibility tracking and analyzing key operational metrics to ensure KPIs/service goals are met




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Notion product expertise

 - Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification

 - Technical knowledge or data querying experience (SQL)

 - Experience contributing to the product development process at a software company



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $61.54 – $67.79 hourly.

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

What You'll Achieve

  • Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

  • Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

  • Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

  • Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

  • Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

  • Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

  • Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

  • Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

  • Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

  • Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

  • Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

  • Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

  • Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

  • You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

  • You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

  • Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

  • Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

  • Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager — Japan Training Quality to support localization for Customer Education, helping ensure Notion training content feels accurate, clear, culturally relevant, and ready to use for learners across the globe.

You’ll work at the intersection of localization quality, training implementation, and program management, collaborating with Localization, Partner Enablement, Customer Education, vendors, and language specialists. You’ll help turn translation feedback, learner experience issues, and regional quality needs into practical improvements across training content, quizzes, LMS setup, and repeatable localization workflows.

The ideal candidate combines native-level Japanese language expertise with a deep understanding of what effective education looks like in the Japanese market.

What You'll Achieve

  • Own and apply Japanese localization QA standards across training content, including checking for accuracy, clarity, tone, terminology, and cultural nuance

  • Support development of glossaries, style guides, QA checklists, review processes, and localization assets

  • Become a go-to partner for translation questions related to Notion-specific concepts, product terminology, and training context

  • Support QA of technical implementation in eLearning authoring tools and LMS environments (course files, quizzes, answer selections)

  • Coordinate across Customer Education, Partner Enablement, Localization, and vendors to align on priorities, timelines, translation progress, and quality expectations

  • Identify workflow risks and recommend improvements that improve translation quality and reduce time-to-launch

  • Document repeatable processes that make training and help center localization easier to manage over time

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • Strong understanding of localization workflows, including vendor collaboration, review cycles, glossaries, style guides, QA rubrics, and linguistic QA

  • Experience with Japanese localization QA, ideally for SaaS, technical training, customer education, or partner enablement content

  • Ability to review translated content for quality, clarity, terminology accuracy, cultural nuance, and learner comprehension

  • Familiarity with eLearning or LMS tools; experience with platforms like Skilljar or Parta authoring tools is a plus

  • Comfort working with technical or product-specific terminology that may not translate directly

  • Strong attention to detail, especially in learner-facing content, quizzes, course setup, formatting, and implementation QA

  • Strong project management skills and ability to bring structure into ambiguous areas

Why this role matters

We want all of our learners should feel like Notion training content was made for them — not simply translated for them. High-quality localization has a direct impact on learner trust, comprehension, launch readiness, and regional enablement outcomes.

This role will help Customer Education and Partner Enablement move faster while raising the quality bar: reducing rework, catching issues before launch, improving vendor feedback loops, and creating a clearer, more repeatable operating model for training localization

This is a 6-month, part-time role with option to extend. Preferred location is Tokyo, but we're open to remote applicants with strong Japanese market expertise and timezone overlap with Japan and Notion's International Experience team.

Availability: 20 hours/week

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

  • Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

  • Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

  • Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

  • Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

  • Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

  • Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

  • Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

  • Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Nice to Haves:

  • Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

  • Fluency in an additional European language

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. About the Role:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.

This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.

You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

  • Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

  • Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

  • Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

  • Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

  • Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

  • Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving

What You'll Achieve:

  • Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

  • Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

  • Partner with regional and functional leaders to turn local learnings into repeatable playbooks, programs, and operating cadences.

  • Create measurement, reporting, and review mechanisms that help teams understand what is working and where to focus.

  • Support the design of customer growth motions that connect Sales, Services, and Partners.

  • Help codify best practices so growth becomes part of the standard operating rhythm, not a set of one-off campaigns.

  • Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from idea to operational execution.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Experience in management consulting, investment banking, business operations, or post-sales GTM operations.

  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; you can turn ambiguous business questions into clear frameworks, insights, and recommendations.

  • Proven ability to design and manage cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.

  • Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders and operating teams, with the ability to align people around a shared plan.

  • Excellent written communication, including crisp strategy docs, program plans, executive updates, and field-facing materials.

  • Comfort working in a global organization where programs need a strong central strategy and room for regional adaptation.

  • Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and bring structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work.

  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about what drives customer adoption, retention, and expansion.

Nice to Haves:

  • Familiarity with usage-based, consumption-based, or product-led growth models.

  • Experience building or scaling global programs across multiple regions or customer segments.

  • Exposure to pricing, packaging, services, partners, or monetization initiatives.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. As Chief of Staff you'll be the strategic copilot to Notion's Global Head of Sales. You'll work directly with our Global Head of Sales on the complex problems and decisions that drive our sales engine.



You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy being at the center of global sales strategy. Whether that's preparing for board meetings, facilitating cross-functional alignment, or representing the sales organization with key stakeholders.



We're looking for someone who gets energized by revolutionary sales challenges like balancing self-serve and enterprise motions, transforming our business motions internally and externally with AI, and identifying new market opportunities. This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as the Global Head of Sales’ trusted partner. You'll help prepare for board meetings, facilitate executive decision-making, and represent the sales org with internal & external stakeholders.

 - Act as a strategic connector for the Sales organization. You'll use your cross-functional knowledge to identify trends, connect dots for stakeholders, and drive increased alignment between teams. This includes working across GTM teams as well as with close partners in EPD, Finance, People, and Legal.

 - Lead cross-functional projects. You'll run cross functional projects and forums to increase alignment for sales. This includes leading our sales organization planning and reporting.

 - Identify and drive forward global sales strategy. You’ll run analysis on the Notion business and opportunities to deepen customer deployments. Through this work you’ll identify opportunities and provide recommendations for the sales business as it continues to grow and scale. In some cases you’ll own the execution of the strategy too.

 - Drive our rhythm of business. You’ll play a key role in driving the weekly sales Leads meeting, spearheading quarterly Sales Lead offsites, and working closely with the Global Head of Sales on regular communications to the sales org.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years experience in senior sales or sales adjacent leadership roles

 - You have previously worked with, advised, and influenced senior executives

 - You seamlessly swap back and forth between strategic thinking and operational details

 - You’re extremely organized and strong in project management - experience leading initiatives from inception through execution

 - You dive deep into projects individually as well as know when to delegate and empower teammates

 - You’re a pace setter, you have previous success operating in fast paced B2B SaaS environments

 - You’re strong and comfortable with both written and verbal communications, a super power is making complex topics sound simple

 - You’re a self starter, you don’t ask for permission - you make it happen

 - You’re a problem solver who leverages first principles thinking and focuses on what’s best for Notion and our customers

 - You’ve started to adopt AI to help you spend more time on the work that matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Background in management consulting, strategy, or operations

 - Experience working in GTM or directly reporting to the C-suite

 - Experience driving initiatives that serve both PLG and Enterprise Sales motions

 - Familiar with using Notion as a product

 - AI power user

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

This early-career Notino Experience Program Manager role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and turns it into momentum. You’ll wear many hats across the People team, but your core job is to jump in, chart the path, and drive high-impact projects based on business priorities—bringing clarity, aligning cross-functional partners, and executing quickly so the team can deliver meaningful employee experiences across EMEA and APAC.

You’ll succeed here if you’re deeply curious, eager to grow, and excited to hone your craft in People. This is a launchpad opportunity to learn from strong leaders, build expertise across the full spectrum of People work, and help shape moments that matter—bringing energy, optimism, and genuine care for people while helping build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

As the regional anchor for how Notion’s global people & environment programs come to life outside the U.S., you’ll sit at the intersection of global vision and local execution. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Notino Experience & Environment Lead for APAC & EMEA, you’ll partner closely with the Global Experience Programs team in AMER and environment teams across Dublin, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, and Hyderabad—translating global programs into locally relevant, high-quality experiences and building the operational infrastructure to deliver them consistently at scale.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own regional program operations. Take end-to-end ownership of key people programs across EMEA and APAC — from onboarding and performance cycles to engagement surveys and talent retention initiatives. You'll research, plan, launch, and iterate.

  • Bridge global and local. Act as the connective layer between the Global Experience Programs team and on-the-ground environment teams. You'll translate global frameworks into locally relevant experiences.

  • Build the infrastructure. Create processes, playbooks, and agents that make local execution easier and more consistent across markets. Think onboarding workflows, program calendars, and repeatable delivery frameworks.

  • Elevate Affinity Groups. Partner with Affinity Group leads across the region to strengthen their programmes, provide operational support, and help surface retention and engagement insights from within those communities.

  • Use data to drive decisions. Build and maintain dashboards that track program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use what you learn to run experiments, course-correct quickly, and demonstrate ROI.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with People Partners, NoE , Recruitment and business leaders to align people programs with organisational goals and ensure an inclusive, well-supported employee experience.

  • Champion the Notion Experience. Help craft and bring to life a more distinct Notino Experience brand across EMEA and APAC — reimagining how we work, how we connect, and what it feels like to be a Notino in your region.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Programatic: experience running people programs end-to-end, across multiple markets & time zones.

  • AI-native mindset: you’re “AI‑pilled” in the best way: you proactively use AI tools to speed up research, ops, and communication, and you’re excited to build AI agents/playbooks.

  • Project management: strong skills and the ability to hold many moving pieces.

  • Stakeholder trust: you build trust naturally across levels, from team members to executive partners.

  • Bias toward action: you’re resourceful, scrappy when needed, and energised by a fast-moving environment.

  • Change management: experience driving change at a high-growth company — you know how to bring people along, not just roll things out.

  • Executive presence: you’re comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leaders.

Nice to Haves:

  • Familiarity with or enthusiasm for Notion

  • Experience working across APAC and EMEA markets, with an understanding of cultural nuance in employee experience.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €60,000 - €70,000 per year.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
